entry.title: Florida's median rent rose 91% from 2010 to 2024, to $1,812 a month.
entry.summary: Housing and Wages: Median gross rent, renter-occupied units paying cash rent, Florida and U.S., 2010 to 2024.

entry.title: Florida's median home value rose 142% from 2010 to 2024, to $396,900.
entry.summary: Housing and Wages: Median value of owner-occupied housing units, Florida and U.S., 2010 to 2024.

entry.title: Since 2010, Florida's median rent rose 33% and median home value 68% after inflation. Median household income rose 22%.
entry.summary: Housing and Wages: Index, 2010 = 100, inflation-adjusted with CPI-U.

entry.title: 62.1% of Florida renters spent 30% or more of income on rent in 2024, the highest share since at least 2010.
entry.summary: Housing and Wages: Renter households spending 30% or more of household income on gross rent, Florida and U.S., 2010 to 2024.

entry.title: Florida had 41 affordable and available rental units for every 100 renter households earning up to 60% of area median income in 2024.
entry.summary: Housing and Wages: Surplus or shortage of rental units affordable and available to renter households, by household income as a share of area median income...

entry.title: At Florida's median wage, a month of median rent took 80 hours of work in 2024. Nationally it took 63.
entry.summary: Housing and Wages: Median monthly gross rent divided by the median hourly wage for all occupations.

entry.title: Florida's average pay rose 18.5% after inflation from 2010 to 2025, faster than the U.S. (14.0%). It remains 7.6% below the U.S. average.
entry.summary: Housing and Wages: Average annual pay, all jobs covered by unemployment insurance, Florida and U.S.

entry.title: Adjusted for Florida's price level, its median wage ranks 50th of 51 jurisdictions. Only Mississippi is lower.
entry.summary: Housing and Wages: Florida's rank among the 50 states and D.C., 2024 (1 = highest), before and after dividing by each state's price level.

entry.title: The monthly cost of a Florida home with a mortgage rose $313 after inflation from 2019 to 2024. Insurance was $67 of it.
entry.summary: Housing and Wages: Average monthly cost for owners with a mortgage, in 2024 dollars.

entry.title: Net domestic migration peaked at 310,892 in 2022 and fell to 22,517 in 2025, 93% below the peak.
entry.summary: Housing and Wages: People moving to Florida from other states, net of those leaving, and net international migration, by Census estimate year.
